messages:
sophia: Quick postmortem follow-up. We captured remediation items for GPU capacity and autoscale; need concise owners + 1-line ETAs so I can push into the tracker by EOD.

mike: I can take scheduler tuning. I'll propose changes to fair_share and preempt_threshold, include a minimal canary plan.

raj: I'll own quota conversations with cloud vendors and our sales channel for enterprise fallbacks. Will open the support request.

_tess: I'll wire up a small automated canary in staging (10% traffic) and capture baseline metrics. Also want an alert for p99 regressions._

nate: Recommend adding a short emergency headroom play to the oncall runbook and a voluntary surge rota. I can draft both.

ops-bot: Ticket opened: INF-3002 \u2014 "Surge headroom quota request" (assignee: raj). https://tracker.redwood.ai/INF-3002

mike: Plan sketch: 
- Run A/B on fair_share weights (x0.8 -> x1.2)
- Tweak preempt_threshold from 0.25 -> 0.18 for low-latency tiers
- Add feature flag `experimental_preempt_v2` and test it in staging
Canary: 10% traffic for 48h, compare p50/p95/p99 and error rates. ETA: 12 business days for full proposal (draft next Wed).

raj: Vendor quota path: open support + fill vendor form; if approval delayed, enable reserved burst capacity and notify Sales to approve emergency uplift. ETA: initial request filed in 2 business days.

_tess: Proposed alert (PromQL):_
```
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(inference_latency_bucket[5m])) by (le, model, tenant))
```
Alert: p99 > 450ms for 10m -> page oncall. I'll add a dashboard tile for canary vs baseline. ETA: 3 days.

nate: Emergency headroom play (runbook stub):
1) Shift non-critical tenants to smaller/quantized model variant (auto-route).
2) Increase autoscale max_instances (if quota) + enable burst_reserve for 20m.
3) Flip `experimental_preempt_v2` OFF and reduce batch sizes to force lower latency.
4) If capacity still saturated -> enable reserved capacity (sales-assisted) and activate overflow throttles for low-priority lanes.
I'll PR to infra/runbooks and add contact list. ETA: 6 days.

sophia: TL;DR owners + ETAs to add to remediations tracker:
- Quota path: raj 3 ETA 2d 3 INF-3002
- Scheduler tuning + canary: mike 3 ETA 12bd (proposal next Wed)
- Canary automation + p99 alert: tess 3 ETA 3d
- Runbook + surge rota: nate 3 ETA 6d

sophia: One ask: each owner add one-line rollback/actions for SRE to execute during an incident (keep them short).

mike: Rollback bullets (1-liners): revert fair_share weights to prior commit; disable `experimental_preempt_v2`; force max_batch_size=8.

raj: Rollback fallback: request emergency quota via sales + enable reserved capacity (short window), or route to cheaper region if vendor limits present.

_tess: I'll add alert play: mute canary traffic and revert routing, then run short A/B to validate baseline.

nate: Runbook: include escalation contacts + exact console path to flip autoscale/burst flags. Will add to PR.

ops-bot: Meeting scheduled: "Headroom & autoscale follow-up" Tue 11:00 4 attendees: sophia, mike, raj, tess, nate

sophia: Thanks. Please post brief updates here as you make progress so the postmortem actions stay live in the tracker. :eyes:

mike: ack

raj: ack

_tess: ack

nate: ack

sophia: I'll import these into the tracker and send a one-pager with the runbook link before the meeting.

ops-bot: Reminder set for the meeting + INF-3002 watcher subscription enabled for the thread.
